summary: Complete issue #434 by making a direct installed-WTSCLI browser readiness probe the sole pre-search gate for production Liepin lanes.
rationale: Verify-session is a repeat-safe browser observation with extension-owned idle cleanup. The production gate therefore verifies the installed WTSCLI runtime and daemon ownership, acquires a real browser control fence, and observes readiness on a separate owned tab without manufacturing Source Port, journal, or runtime-control authority. Splitting the wiring from deletion would leave the retired ensure-ready and session-status route available as a production bypass.
deletion_targets: production Liepin search readiness through worker ensure_ready or session_status
ready results that echo an expected provider account reference as browser-observed identity
live Liepin provider construction without the single verify-session gate
instant owned-tab close or backend-owned normal tab reclamation
verification: uv run --group dev pytest -q tests/test_source_port_verify_session_contract.py tests/test_wtscli_verify_session_adapter.py tests/test_liepin_provider_adapter.py tests/test_liepin_runtime_source_lane.py tests/test_runtime_multi_source_round_dispatch.py
uv run --group dev ruff check src tests experiments tools
uv run --group dev ty check src tests tools
uv run --group dev python tools/check_privacy_gate.py --base origin/main
uv run --group dev python tools/check_agent_safety_gate.py --base origin/main
uv run --group dev python tools/check_ai_bad_smells.py --base origin/main
uv run --group dev python tools/check_pr_governance.py --base origin/main
risks: Any Liepin search effect before direct WTSCLI browser verification would recreate the production bypass.
Connection safety rejection must occur before the browser gate so denied or expired connections cannot open a verification tab.
The Source Port journal and reconciliation composition remains intact but production-unreachable; this gate must not simulate it in process.
Borrowed user tabs may select a Chrome window only; all navigation and observation must remain on a separate inactive owned tab.
No concrete Liepin account identity may be extracted, hashed, persisted, compared, or claimed by this gate.
